# SIMULATED DOCUMENT: written for the OrbitFlow demo. It is not issued by any regulator.

## 1 Purpose
This notice sets a temporary limit on satellite beam power over cells whose footprint spills into a neighbouring jurisdiction, to limit transboundary interference.

## 2 Border cell power cap
Beams illuminating listed border cells must not exceed the transmit power cap stated in the notice. The cap applies per beam and per slot from the effective slot until withdrawn.

## 3 Coordination with the neighbouring administration
The operator must coordinate any change in border beam power with the neighbouring administration. Automated controllers must apply the limit before transmission.

## 4 Reporting
The operator must keep a record of every slot in which a proposed beam power was reduced to comply with the cap.
